# Ads

> Create ads in ChatGPT and measure website conversions with the Measurement Pixel, authentication, campaigns, product feeds, ad groups, ads, uploads, and insights.

Use this as a compact map of the Ads docs. Each page has a Markdown twin at `/ads/<slug>.md`.

## Documentation sets
- [Combined Ads docs](https://developers.openai.com/ads/llms-full.txt): Single-file Markdown export of the Ads docs.

## Api Overview
- [Overview](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-overview.md): Advertiser API endpoints & usage

## Api Partner Setup
- [API partner setup](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-partner-setup.md): Configure client accounts, conversions, and campaigns with the Ads API.

## Api Quickstart
- [Quickstart](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-quickstart.md): Launch your first Ads API workflow

## Api Reference
- [Ad account](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/ad-account.md): Update and retrieve account metadata.
- [Ad Groups](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/ad-groups.md): Create, list, retrieve, update, and change ad group state.
- [Ads](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/ads.md): Create, list, retrieve, update, and change ad state.
- [Authentication](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/authentication.md): Setting up bearer token authentication.
- [Campaigns](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/campaigns.md): Create, list, retrieve, update, and change campaign state.
- [Conversion setup](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/conversion-setup.md): Create pixels, Conversions API keys, and event settings.
- [Files](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/files.md): Upload remote images or binary files and reuse the returned file ID in ad creatives.
- [Insights](https://developers.openai.com/ads/api-reference/insights.md): Retrieve aggregated insights data across ad account, campaigns, ad groups, and ads.

## Campaign Targeting
- [Campaign Targeting](https://developers.openai.com/ads/campaign-targeting.md): Target campaigns by country, region, or DMA.

## Conversions Api
- [Conversions API](https://developers.openai.com/ads/conversions-api.md): Server-to-server conversion events.

## Image Tag
- [Image tag](https://developers.openai.com/ads/image-tag.md): Send conversion events from HTML without JavaScript.

## Measurement Pixel
- [JavaScript Pixel](https://developers.openai.com/ads/measurement-pixel.md): Send conversion events from web pages.

## Product Feeds
- [Product feeds](https://developers.openai.com/ads/product-feeds.md): Use a merchant catalog to create and measure product-feed ads.

## Supported Events
- [Supported events](https://developers.openai.com/ads/supported-events.md): Supported conversion events & data shapes.
